mentalModelCheck.question: When xmpp_session_registry terminates abnormally under rest_for_one, why is xmpp_router terminated and restarted even if it experienced no internal errors?

options.label: The router depends on the registry's ETS table. Restarting the router ensures it reconnects to the newly created ETS table rather than crashing on stale references.
options.explanation: Correct! Under rest_for_one, child processes booted after the failed process are terminated and restarted in forward sequence, guaranteeing all downstream dependencies re-synchronize with the fresh upstream state.

options.label: In OTP, rest_for_one is an alias for one_for_all and terminates all processes unconditionally.
options.explanation: rest_for_one only terminates siblings started after the failed process; earlier siblings remain unaffected.

options.label: The BEAM runtime automatically kills all processes that share the same atom table.
options.explanation: Process isolation guarantees that one process crash does not kill others unless linked or managed by a supervisor.
